description: Catalogue of short side stories: title text, script to play, prerequisite/sequel link and the cast row to use.

ID.technical: FName key in ShortStoryDataTables (DTM +0xA30). Used as the StudioStoryDemoSeen_630 state key, as the item VariableId for ownership checks, as the list item's row name, and as the argument of Story_GetShortStoryScriptId.

Id_StoryText_Title.simple: Localized-text id shown as the short-story button title.
Id_StoryText_Title.technical: FName (row +0x10) passed to SetButtonTextId(..., EApplicationLanguage::Invalid) by the relation short-story list item. No string formatting is done by the table consumer.

Id_Script.simple: Script row to play for this short story.
Id_Script.technical: FName (row +0x18). Story_GetShortStoryScriptId returns it without a null-row check; UGamePhase_StoryDemoShortStory::GetScriptId supplies StudioStoryDiagramDemoId_CF8 as the short-story id and passes the returned script id to the normal script phase.

Id_ShortStory.simple: Optional linked short story that unlocks the read state.
Id_ShortStory.technical: FName (row +0x20). During MainMenuStory update, a short story with Seen == 1 becomes Seen == 2 when this field is None, or when the linked story's StudioStoryDemoSeen_630 value is >= 3; otherwise it stays unread.

Id_ShortStoryCharacter.simple: Cast row for this short story.
Id_ShortStoryCharacter.technical: FName row id used to find a ShortStoryCharacter row in DTM +0xA40 before filtering the relation detail list and before rendering the list item; a missing cast row drops the story from those consumers.

notes: Only six exported rows set Id_ShortStory; the rest are None and are treated as immediately readable once owned.
The script field is used directly for the short-story demo phase; the table itself has no separate map or BGM fields (those live in ScriptDataTable).
No localization variants of this table were exported; text localization is expected to live in the text-table ids rather than per-locale rows.

Evidence is from the reconstructed C++ in Source/ (row shape/counts from the exported table); status/ records byte matches for some owner TUs, but this file does not claim a retail byte comparison for every function or exhaustive Blueprint/runtime coverage.

usages.detail: Advances per-short-story seen state from owned (1) to readable (2), honouring the Id_ShortStory prerequisite.
Builds the relation detail short-story list for the selected character pair.
Displays title, cast faces, new marker and lock state for one short-story row.
Resolves the ShortStory row to its playable Script id.
Uses short-story cast and seen state for pair 'new content' notification.
